subject.title: Memory MVP: implement source attribution and provenance model

question: What native provenance contract should durable OpenClaw memory use across memory-core, QMD, MEMORY.md promotion, Memory Wiki bridge inputs, and review/edit flows?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the durable data model, merge/edit semantics, source authority, and cross-plugin boundary need maintainer product direction before implementation.

options.title: Define Native Provenance Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical provenance tracker and define structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before coding.

options.title: Fold Into Schema Foundation First
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42646 the schema/design prerequisite, then implement this issue once record and revision ownership are settled.

options.title: Leave Wiki As Optional Layer
options.body: Document Memory Wiki as the provenance-rich optional layer while leaving active memory's native promotion and retrieval contracts unchanged for now.

recommendation.title: Define Native Provenance Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical provenance tracker and define structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before coding.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest available current-source and prior-review routing signal for the memory host SDK and memory-core contract boundary.
